mapper.select: SELECT stock_id AS stockId, name FROM stocks ORDER BY stock_id

SELECT stock_id AS stockId, name, content, publication_balance AS publicationBalance, publication_price AS publicationPrice, prev_price AS prevPrice, COALESCE(status, 'LISTED') AS status FROM stocks ORDER BY stock_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stocks (name, content, publication_price, publication_balance, prev_price, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{content}, #{publicationPrice}, #{publicationBalance}, #{publicationPrice}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'LISTED'))
mapper.update: UPDATE stocks SET name = #{request.name}, content = #{request.content}, publication_price = #{request.publicationPrice}, publication_balance = #{request.publicationBalance}, status = COALESCE(#{request.status}, 'LISTED') WHERE stock_id = #{stockId}
